items.title: William Russell Interview, 1976-02-16
items.q: The interviewee discusses 'Bro' (likely Buddy Bolden or a similar figure referred to as 'Bro' in the interviewer's prompt) only in the context of the interviewer's question about a 1940 band with Louis and Bechet. ctx.x: I mean, look at, well, 1940, I was thinking about Louis and Bechet getting together in that band. Bro on bass, you know, where they made the Colcord Blues and done it. Wanky Dock Town and all those things.

By the way, when they, they had an Esquire program, they had an all-star band, you know, Esquire. And so they gave some of the awards down here. I think it was a three-way hookup they had. Benny Goodman was in New York, somebody in San Francisco, and Louis, I believe, in New Orleans. The three of them or so got together. Well, anyway, they played one piece over earphones.
